scripts.android:init: npm run build:public && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:public && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:init: npm run build:public && npm install @capacitor/ios@7.4.3 --no-save && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:public && npm install @capacitor/ios@7.4.3 --no-save && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify:pwa && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
